_comment: Authoring input of the whole Coach Motion V2 pipeline: capture.mjs (jobs), guards.py (checks), encode.py (clips + manifest), plan.mjs (job list, pack-size estimate) all derive from THIS file; nothing hardcodes a state or an edge. It is copied into every pack manifest (minus the authoring-only keys); the player reads it from there. A new loop or edge is added here, next to its pose definition (apps/web/features/coach-motion/loop-pose.ts) and its generated frames, not in player code.
_edges: `ns` is the edge's unique namespace: its head clips / frame folders are `<headClipPrefix><phase:3>` / `<headDirPrefix><phase:3>` and no head prefix may be a prefix of another. `entry.stride` <= the source loop's `strideLimit` (the stride probe's recommendation: apps/web/features/coach-motion/stride-probe.ts) and `maxStepFrames` = floor(stride / 2).

budget._comment: Generation gates, in bytes (decimal MB, the strict reading). firstLoad = the effective initial Hero motion path (the first loop, then per hop: the armed heads, the tail, the target loop); packCeiling = STOP / REASSESS ceiling for the whole 384 / 30 fps semantic pack, not a target. A projection above the ceiling stops capture and encode.

calibration._comment: Encoded AVIF bytes per frame at 384 px / q35 / speed 4, MEASURED on the committed full semantic pack (prod/384, a test keeps them honest within 1 %). A new loop starts as the largest measured rate plus a 10 % margin, listed in `unmeasured`, until a real render replaces it.
